text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racecourse is abuzz with excitement about the showdown between Silence Suzuka, the Otherworldly Front-Runner, and Air Groove, the Empress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two exchange few words as they approach their challenge.
